Veterans Benefits: Nevada has no individual income tax, so military retirement income is not taxed at the state level; qualifying veterans and disabled veterans may receive property-tax exemptions, and disabled veterans with at least a 60% permanent service-connected disability may apply the exemption toward real property or vehicle registration taxes.

Description: Elko is a high-desert northeastern Nevada city at the edge of the Ruby Mountains, with a local VA clinic, no state income tax, and a strong mining and ranching economy. Retirees get direct access to Lamoille Canyon, mountain trails, fishing, golf, Basque and Western cultural events, and a small-city service hub, while housing costs and winter snowfall are higher than many low-desert Nevada options.
